Problem: Find the greatest four-digit number where all digits are distinct, and which is divisible by each of its digits. Zero cannot be used.

The digits 9, 8, 7, and 6 are all distinct, so 9876 should not be rejected for having repeated digits.
Correctly recognize that 9876 has distinct digits, then test whether 9876 is divisible by each of 9, 8, 7, and 6.
